About Majestic Home Solutions

At Majestic Home Solutions, we know part of our job as Rochester Hills's top remodeler is creating close, quality connections with our customers. That's why we remain open and honest about our process and work. We remain committed to making our customers feel comfortable each step of the way.

In 2005, Majestic was reorganized into the top-tier family-owned business you see today, Majestic Home Solutions, LLC. Our Process
OUR REMODELING PROCESS
STEP ONE

Dreaming

At our first meeting we prioritize getting to know each other. We will discuss what type of vision you have for your project space. You can share any inspiration photos you have and let us know what needs and wants are important to you. During your in-home consultation we will take preliminary measurements and photos to start up your project file. We will also discuss the project budget. All this information will be crucial for us to prepare you a detailed estimate.

STEP TWO

Designing

Next you’ll receive a preliminary plan and estimate for approval. After any necessary revisions are made we will move forward by signing a design agreement or a construction contract. The DA will allow you extra allotted hours with our design team to create 3D renderings of your project and project selections. We use Chief Architect® software to create interior renderings that are industry-leading. You will be able to visualize your dream space vividly! This is a great tool to make sure your custom bar or kitchen is exactly what you have in mind before construction begins.

STEP THREE

Pre-Construction

After the construction contract has been signed we will get you set up with a client BuilderTrend account. This will be your project’s communication center; it will have up to date selections, schedules, change orders, and daily logs recorded by our crew to ensure your project is on time and running smoothly. Our design team will help assist you through the material selection process. We will ensure all your materials are ordered and on-site before we begin construction.

STEP FOUR

Construction

During construction we will be updating you throughout the project progress. Before each trade begins we will schedule respective walk-thrus to review the plan and ensure everyone is on the same page. We utilize detailed checklists during each phase of construction to make sure tasks are completed orderly and accurately. The Majestic team is always available to address any concerns and questions that may arise during construction. We will be prompt to update you on anything that may require change orders or credits due to changes in scope of work. Finally we will have a punch list walkthrough and completion date before the final payment is collected.

STEP FIVE

Post Construction

After the project is completed, we will honor an 18 month limited warranty for your project. Once you are moved back in and settled, we look forward to visiting and taking professional pictures of the job to share. At this time we enjoy reviewing the project and discussing the experience with you. Our goal is to make this process an enjoyable and stress-free experience for you! We want you to love the enhancements to your home and share your experience with others who would benefit from our services. Be sure to check out our Refer a Friend program!

Design Agreements

At Majestic Home Solutions, we believe that a successful remodel starts long before the first nail is driven. Our Design Agreement is the ideal first step for homeowners who want to explore the full details of their project — including material selections, virtual renderings, and a clear construction plan — before committing to a full contract.

Our Design Agreement is a great option for clients who want to get into the finer details of their project prior to committing to a company. It gives you an opportunity to see exactly what your space will look like, understand the full scope of work, and feel completely confident before moving forward.

About Us
A design-build firm committed to fostering a culture of excellence while building lifelong relationships with our clients.
The Owner's Story
My story:
       I decided I wanted to be a remodeler while pursuing a degree to become a teacher back in 2003. I wasn’t sure exactly how to go about it, but I knew that’s what I wanted to do. I finished my Associates in Liberal Arts and then started taking Construction Management classes at WCC. I received my Michigan Residential Builders license in 2006.
       I started Ann Arbor Remodeling LLC in 2013. It has been an interesting journey so far. I truly love working with clients and my team, and bringing designs to life. The projects we take on are not always easy or straight forward, but I take great joy in the final result as well as the process to get there.
       Building a team has been the most rewarding part of the process. By following the principals laid out in The Ideal Team Player, finding and hiring the right people has been quite a fulfilling process. While others in the industry have complained for years that there is no good help out there, we have hired for character and personality and developed the skills along the way.  It truly takes a team to deliver a phenomenal client experience, and that has been what I have been striving for since founding the company.
       I am grateful I found something I love to do at a young age and that I was able to figure out how to make a career out of it. I am thankful for our team and our clients, and I look forward to continuing to take on new and exciting projects.
 
Justin Kolic
Contact us
View portfolio
Principles Of Our Work
1. We put our employees first

Our employees are the key to delivering a great experience to our clients. We believe in creating jobs that offer growth and the ability to have work/life balance.

2. Client experience

Delivering exceptional workmanship is not the only factor in a successful job. Getting to the finish line is not our goal. We believe delivering an exceptional experience to our clients is the key to a successful project. We do this by having open and frequent communication, setting realistic expectations from the start, and always doing the right thing.

3. Fostering a culture of craftsmanship

Our goal is to do the highest quality work that we are capable of, and not focusing how fast we can get it done. This intentional focus allows our younger generation to develop skills, and our experienced craftsman to keep their passion for the craft alive. We believe this is the key to developing and retaining unskilled workers and transforming them into craftsman. There is a shortage of skilled craftsman nationwide, and we are doing our part to create solutions to this issue.

4. Transparency

Unlike many remodeling companies that include hidden markups in their line-item pricing, we provide a clear breakdown of the actual costs. This includes what we pay our trade partners and the direct cost of your chosen finish materials. For example, if a fixture like a toilet costs us $478, that exact amount is what you'll see on your contract. This approach ensures that we are truly on the same side of the table. It fosters a more trusting and relaxed environment when discussing any potential changes to the project scope or material selections. Our primary goal is to be our client's advocate throughout the entire remodeling process.

Our clients love our company!
Steve G.

Justin is just absolutely wonderful to work with. He truly wants you to be happy, and with no judgement, he will always find a way to address any concerns that you have. Honest, transparent, communication, along with a schedule that is surprisingly accurate, add to making the entire experience working with Justin and his team as good as possible.

Dyan A.

I wanted to let you know how tremendously pleased we are with the basement and bathroom remodeling project that you just completed in our home. Your wonderful design consultation opened our eyes to the possibilities that existed for our home. Ann Arbor Remodeling provided me with the quality, service and honest integrity that made my dreams come true.

Alan J.

Justin and his team did a fantastic job with our Trex deck build. His input in the design phase was exactly what we were looking for, and the quality and care showed in his build techniques. Not only did they build the deck but designed an integrated gas fire pit that we have already used to cook amazing Smores after dinner with the neighbors. Thank you Ann Arbor Remodeling!

Kim & Victor D.

Ann Arbor Remodeling did an absolutely fantastic job. We had major water damage in our kitchen from a leak in our upstairs bathroom. We hired Justin once we heard back from our insurance company. Justin was so helpful; working with the insurance company, calling them to update them. It was so great that he took the extra time to do all the added work for our unfortunate situation. And he turned our kitchen into the nicest kitchen I have literally ever seen! He expanded our walls, completely reconfigured the kitchen setup, refinished our hardwood floors, installed all new appliances, granite, cabinets, and the list goes on. He also touched base with me almost daily to get our feedback and see if there was anything else that we wanted to change, update, or fix. He is a perfectionist and takes pride in his work.  What more could you ask for? Thanks Justin!! 

Mike R.

Ann Arbor Remodeling did a great job on the renovation of our master bathroom. The work was professional; completed on time and within our budget. Justin worked closely with us and gave us some great ideas to simplify the project and reduce costs. I would confidently recommend Ann Arbor Remodeling and will plan on using them for future projects around our home.

Teresa H.

Such a great experience working with Justin and David and the entire crew. Professional, on time, and on budget. They helped us through our first big renovation. They added a bathroom where a closet used to be- a second floor laundry where a bathroom used to be – and a walk-in closet with custom built dresser where an office used to be! Our house was always clean and neat at the end of each day- and we just love our new space. Highly recommended company and they are our first call if we want to renovate something else!

Amit S.

Justin and his team have delivered several high-quality projects for our house. Not only is his work of the highest quality, but he’s an excellent and honest communicator. Even the slightest concern gets addressed in a timely fashion. He takes genuine pride in his work and it shows.

Kim D.

We had a great renovation experience. Having worked with other builders, Ann Arbor Remodeling was hands down the most organized and best communicators. Keeping in mind that we were living in the space during the work, the team was super respectful of our space and kept everything very clean. In the end our bathroom and master bed look fantastic! We highly recommend!

Jessie N.

We have used Justin and his teams for multiple projects. He and his team are amazing. They are easy to work with, great at communicating any issues, and do incredible work. They have tiled multiple bathrooms and I always get compliments about the work they have done. I highly recommend them to anyone who asks.

Maria C.

Can’t say enough good things about the A2 Remodeling team and their work on our entire first floor and partial second floor remodel. You hear horror stories of contractors being horrible communicators, cutting corners, unexpected costs. There was none of that. Daily/Weekly pictures and updates of the project, always on schedule, it just goes on. They put up giant beams, new windows, built rooms, brand new kitchen, and more and it is all perfect. Highly recommend if you are looking for high quality extremely professional work from a team who are passionate, excited and extremely knowledgeable about what they do.

Dan A.

I can’t say enough good things about Justin and his team at Ann Arbor Remodeling. Communication skills are excellent, workmanship is excellent. He’s responsive and willing to discuss options. I’ve hired Justin for a couple of different projects now and he delivers quality work in the quoted amount of time… started on time, finished on time. Can’t ask for any more than that.

Jason Q.

We had Ann Arbor Remodeling completely renovate our basement a few months back and we couldn’t be more satisfied with the job they did. The finished product exceeded our expectations and is absolutely beautiful.
Justin is a very honest and detail-oriented business owner. A few times he had vendors come back and redo work that was performed that was not up to his standards. I hadn’t even noticed or asked. This is a rare trait with contractors and really sets this business apart from their competition.
Phil was our on-site project lead and he is a very kind and hardworking craftsman. His attention to small details was excellent.
I couldn’t recommend a renovation contractor any higher than Ann Arbor Remodeling. We will definitely be return customers.

Lisa L.

We have hired Ann Arbor Remodeling for 3 projects over the last 3 years: (1) the replacement of our deck and patio, (2) turning our unfinished basement into an office and living space, and finally (3) a complete remodel of our first floor, including removal of a partial wall and complete redesign of the kitchen/dining area. All three projects have dramatically increased our enjoyment (and the value!) of our home, and we have Justin and his team to thank for that.
We can’t recommend this company enough – from Justin’s design sense and outstanding communication skills to his teams’ conscientiousness, attention to detail, and professionalism – this is one contractor you can count on to keep you informed and engaged on your project. A remodel is a significant investment, and we’ve trusted Justin and his team on multiple occasions now with zero regrets. It’s not a coincidence that so many of our neighbors have recommended Ann Arbor Remodeling to each other over the last few years – they are above and beyond the best we’ve experienced!

Arthur W.

Ann Arbor Remodeling did an outstanding job on remodeling my basement last year. Justin Kolic and his workers were professional and delivered the remodel as planned. They were extra conscientious on there cleanliness of the area and my home. Always courteous and performed the work at the quoted price. I would highly recommend Justin an Ann Arbor Remodeling without reservation.

Dan P.

Justin and his team are great to work with. We had a multi-room complex remodel, and he was able to help design and execute with high proficiency. His communication skills are great. We received excellent value for his project. Strongly recommend him.

Kristen B.

We have used Justin and Team twice now. Once for our basement remodel and then for our first floor and kitchen remodel. The level of professionalism and attention to detail was bar none the best. In both cases we were guided through extensive renovations when we had little prior experience with this kind of thing. Expectations were always appropriately set and MET. Thank you Justin and Phil for helping us put together our dream kitchen!!

Abhijat N.

My words here will NOT do justice to Justin and David and the entire crew at Ann Arbor remodeling. But hey I will try!
We hired AA remodeling to finish our basement after interviewing many contractors. Factors that went into hiring them was (1) Reasonable cost, (2) Reviews and (3) Our own gut feeling about Justin when we met him. Justin appeared to be a solid human with the integrity and work ethic that is hard (rather close to impossible) in this area of work. That was the single most important thing for me. Nathan and all the other crew were great! My wife and I both work and they were working while we were out (including on a vacation). We trusted them entirely and were not let down.
The finished product was amazing. We now have an additional office, a bathroom, bedroom, gym, custom bar and a large living space!! This will be a cozy and comfortable place for our entire family and friends for years to come.
To summarize if you are looking for highly skilled, collegial, technologically savvy and trustworthy people for your home improvement projects. Looks no further.

Careers
Join our talented team!
Career Opportunities
We are always looking to add rockstars to our team. We seek those who are motivated, work with integrity, and work with a smile.  We will train the right individual.
To excel in this company, you must be a team-minded person. We strive to offer the highest quality work and the best possible experience for our clients.  Many companies say this, but we truly mean it. This means we are continually trying to improve out techniques and systems.  We don’t settle for “it is what it is” or “that’s how we always have done it.”

The three traits we look for when interviewing are: Humble, Hungry, and Smart. For a in-depth explanation of these three traits, check out the book The Ideal Team Player by Pat Lencioni. 

Compensation: Competitive pay, includes 401k match and profit sharing, holiday pay, PTO (vacation and sick days) and paid training opportunities.  Most recently, we went down to Louisville to the Remodeling and Deck Expo where we attended training sessions and toured the expo.

Below are position descriptions
(not necessarily open positions)
Project Manager

A fast paced position requiring extensive construction experience, excellent communication and organizational skills. Our Project Managers run our larger projects (full home remodels and additions). While other companies have their Project Managers run 4-10 projects at a time, we think 3 projects at a time is the most effective and provides the best experience to our clients.

 
Lead Carpenter
Our Lead Carpenters run our smaller projects (bathroom renovations to first floor renovations). They focus on one project at a time. Excellent communication skills are required. Ability to problem-solve, schedule trade partners, and write change orders.  Must have a self-start attitude and willingness to work within a team atmosphere.
Carpenter
ˈkärpən(t)ər/
noun
a person who makes and repairs wooden objects and structures.
 
At Ann Arbor Remodeling, we highly respect the skilled trades and appreciate old world craftsmanship. We believe a carpenter should be a craftsman, and much more than the common misconception that carpenters only work with wood. Our carpenters are well versed in multiple areas. One day they might be framing an addition, and the next fabricating a concrete countertop. They might build a custom built-in cabinet, and then take it through the finishing process. We invest in training and take a group approach to problem solving. 

This means the type of person we look for to be a carpenter on our team, is someone who believes in continual improvement. They aim for perfection, settling for excellence, knowing perfection is never achievable.

Apprentice Carpenter
Must be motivated with a willingness to learn.  Work daily under our team of skilled craftsman along with the opportunity to take construction classes at WCC paid for by Ann Arbor Remodeling.

We also offer online training for our apprentices through Mt. Copeland.

Designer

This position is the key to our beautiful projects. Without thoughtful design, it doesn’t matter how talented our craftsman are, they can’t create magic from a poor design.

The key to an exceptional designer is being a great listener that is able to confidently articulate ideas to our clients without being overbearing. Each of our projects is tailor fit to our clients. 

Our designers listen to our clients needs, create a design that works for the client, and then develops the necessary details to handoff the project to our production team. This includes: Selections, Take-offs, Cut-sheets

Our Process
Continual improvement since 2013
Conceptual Design

It all starts with design!

The objective of this phase is to clearly define the parameters of your project. Topics discussed include but are not limited to: Scope of work, time frame, budget and client expectations.

After the Project Design Agreement is Signed and the deposit is collected we begin this first phase:

Design Kick-off Meeting

At this meeting you will be introduced to your designer, we will discuss your design priorities in depth, explore your personal aesthetic and do a detailed measure of your space.

Conceptual Design Meeting

At this meeting, your designer will show you 2-3 conceptual designs for your space. We will review cost ranges associated with each design option.

Our goal at this meeting will be to further define the scope of the project and decide on a design direction. Often, the design direction is a hybrid of the design options shown.

Depending on the size of your project this step sometimes requires more than one meeting.

Design Development

The objective of this phase is to further refine the design. Topics discussed include but are not limited to: Cabinetry Design, Material Selections, Design Details.

Once our Conceptual Design is aligned with our budget we move into Phase 2, Design Development:

Design Development Meeting(s)

At this series of meetings, your designer will focus on the details of the design. We will walk you through cabinetry design, materials selections, plumbing fixture selections, lighting and electrical layouts and all custom details.

Your designer will present you with material palettes for each area to consider and keep you informed of how they fit within the budget.

Depending on the size of your project, the number of Design Development Meetings required will vary.

As you work through the details with your designer, they will be simultaneously developing the final drawing set used for permits and construction.

Pre-Construction

The objective of this phase is to prepare for construction. We will finalize design and selections, present and review the construction contract and final scope, and introduce you to your production team that will be executing your project.

Once all selections and designs have been finalized we move into the Pre-Construction Phase:

Construction Contract Meeting

At this meeting we will present and review the contract, plans and final scope of work. If all looks good, the construction contract is signed and construction deposit is paid.

Apply for Permits.

Pre-Construction Meeting

This is your opportunity to meet your Project Manager. Your Project Manager will review daily procedures followed during construction and address any of your concerns. They will also review the project schedule and any key dates and project logistics.

Construction

The objective of this phase is to build your project! We will maintain open lines of communication throughout the project with meetings for certain milestones. Design is also involved at key points throughout construction.

Once permits have been approved and all pre-construction tasks complete we begin the Construction Phase:

Communication with Production Team

Your Project Manager will communicate with you regularly on progress, schedule, change orders and any unforeseen issues.

Your Project Manager will schedule milestone meetings at key progress points throughout the project to ensure the project is progressing as intended.

Additional meetings will be scheduled as required.

You will have access to our cloud based project management software, Buildertrend. This is the platform that we communicate the schedule, daily logs, pictures, etc.

Design Involvement

Your designer will be assisting at key points along the way. Including: Paint Selections, Tile Review Meeting and Cabinetry Install Meeting.

Our Services
Always do more than is required of you!
Additions
Add more space to your home!

An addition project can be life changing for a family (and has been for many of our clients).  Additions can be large or small. We excel at addition projects due to our design and pre-construction process. Our process includes a discovery day at the home opening up drywall and determining project specifics. This minimizes the chance of schedule disruptions throughout the project.

Interior Remodeling
Kitchens, Bathrooms, and Basements

We excel at these projects as we use the Lead Carpenter System. That means we have one Project Manager (the Lead Carpenter) assigned to each project, and only one project at a time. The level of service provided is unparalleled to the standard project manager system where a PM runs multiple projects. On our Lead Carpenter projects, there is no wondering when or if someone is showing up or who to talk to about any issues. The Lead Carpenter is there from Day 1 until the end of the project.

Sunroom Additions
Sunroom or Screen Porch Additions

Adding a room that connects the outdoors and indoors can be a great place to hang out. It can be a relaxing spot to read a book or an inviting space for a dinner with friends and family.

Custom Woodworking
Bookcases, Built-in Cabinetry, and More

Why is there such a variety in pricing between companies?
Why does Ann Arbor Remodeling have a transparent pricing model?
At Ann Arbor Remodeling, we believe in open and honest communication, especially when it comes to pricing. That’s why we operate with complete transparency in all our construction contracts.
 
Unlike many remodeling companies that include hidden markups in their line-item pricing, we provide a clear breakdown of the actual costs. This includes what we pay our trade partners and the direct cost of your chosen finish materials. For example, if a fixture like a toilet costs us $478, that exact amount is what you’ll see on your contract.
 
This approach ensures that we are truly on the same side of the table as our client. It fosters a more trusting and relaxed environment when discussing any potential changes to the project scope or material selections. Our primary goal is to be a client advocate throughout the entire remodeling process.
What is a Lead Carpenter?

Our company employs the Lead Carpenter System for interior remodeling projects where clients remain in their homes throughout construction, such as kitchen or bathroom renovations and basement finishes. For additions and larger-scale projects, we utilize the Project Manager System.

Definition of a Lead Carpenter: According to our standards, a Lead Carpenter serves as a Project Manager who remains hands-on, crafting and managing one project at a time and being present onsite from inception through completion. The Lead Carpenter acts as the primary point of contact for the client, maintains a clean work environment, coordinates with inspectors, and oversees all trade partners involved. By dedicating themselves to a single project, the Lead Carpenter provides focused attention, which is especially valuable when clients are residing onsite during the inherently disruptive construction process.

A significant advantage of the Lead Carpenter System is it’s predictability. The Lead Carpenter is typically onsite Monday through Friday, from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., ensuring clients know who will be present each day. We have found that this consistency is crucial in reducing stress for clients living through a construction project.

McDonald Remodeling celebrates design down to the last detail. Details make or break a good design and challenging design is our specialty. We relish the chance to dig into our rich knowledge base to come up with a creative and finely crafted transformation for your home.

ABOUT US

McDonald Remodeling is a full-service residential design/build firm serving Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Twin Cities suburbs since 2000 — offering remodeling of spaces throughout the home, including kitchens, bathrooms, lower levels, whole-home renovations, outdoor living and more.
